theme: Good news days: Over the moon, Make up, Break a leg...

pages.title: Make up
pages.meaning: to become friends again after a fight
examples: They argued but made up later.
tip: make up a story -> invent it

pages.title: Each vs Every
pages.intro: Both mean all, one by one.

pages.title: Over the moon
examples: She was over the moon with her gift.
We're over the moon about the news.

pages.title: Look up
examples: Look up the word in a dictionary.
I looked up the train times.
tip: look it up -> 'it' in the middle

pages.title: Break a leg
examples: Break a leg in your show!
